name: @kanzo-tech/ai
description: Kanzo AI surfaces — a field the model helps fill (Assist) and a conversation with one (Chat), over the AI SDK through @kanzo-tech/llm. Sibling of @kanzo-tech/ui, not part of it.
//eval: `eval/` is Ask's evaluation set, outside `files`, so npm never sees it: `eval:corpus` writes its corpora into the docs' `public/corpus/` with fossil's writer, and `eval` asks every case of the model in the page on the docs' `/fixtures/ask-eval` — by hand, on a machine with a GPU, never in `test` or `verify` (`/docs/design/testing`, *Ask's evaluation set lives beside Ask*). `EVAL_DOUBLE=1 pnpm eval` is the smoke run, on the model double.
//peers: @kanzo-tech/ui and Ark are required peers rather than dependencies — two copies of Ark would mean two portals and two focus traps. `ai` and `@ai-sdk/react` are REQUIRED peers for the reason @kanzo-tech/llm gives: the host's agent and these components must share one UIMessage, one transport and one useChat. streamdown is a dependency now: Chat renders markdown, and a conversation that draws plain text is not one this package offers. `@kanzo-tech/mosaic` is OPTIONAL: only `./data` imports it, beside `@kanzo-tech/ui`'s `/analytics` and `/table`, whose own optional peers a host of `./data` installs too. `@tanstack/react-query` is OPTIONAL for the same reason: `./data`'s reads are queries on the host's client (`/docs/design/reads`), and the root -- `Chat`, `Assist` -- reads nothing through it.
//gauges: One gauge per published entry, and one per tree-shaken import a consumer meets; `scripts/gauges.mjs` (through `.size-limit.mjs`) is what each measures, and every limit's reason — each raise, dated, with its before and after — is a row on /docs/design, *A gauge per entry, and its raises written here*.
